I've sort of ran this idea by the mods here before, but so far I haven't seen any stickied post on this subverse talking about it, so here goes.

TeamSpeak

For folks that don't know, TeamSpeak is a popular voice chat system, especially in the gaming realm. Voice chat servers can be hosted professionally via a hosting company, or self-hosted using whatever the host's machine is. In my (and Techtronix') case, we run a TeamSpeak that is open for use by any IRC channel on the network.

Dinner Sessions

The major idea that I have had with the TeamSpeak server is perhaps having actual dinner sessions. We can all grab a meal (or not), sit down, and talk on the TeamSpeak. Especially with voice activation, you literally don't even have to touch your computer to talk. That is, after you've connected to voice chat, of course.

I can especially see an idea like this taking off during weekends, as most people are busy during the work week (as I am, usually).

Feedback

Please let the mods and I know if you folks are interested in this sort of thing. If all goes well, we actually could have some kind of TeamSpeak session happen very soon.
